transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We need to get ahead of tomorrow's 0900 resupply flight. Per our normal procedure, we'll hold the 0730 cargo huddle to confirm placement constraints before I sign the load plan. We have four cargo lots — the battery pallet, refrigerated clinic shipment, generator-filter crate, and communications-cable pallet — and four positions: P1 forward-left, P2 forward-right, P3 aft-left, and P4 aft-right. I need each of you to bring your specific placement constraints to the huddle so we can sort out tie-down, power, clearance, and segregation requirements before the aircraft crew accepts the cargo. Let's hear what constraints each of you is working with.

I should also note that the updated cargo-certification sheet documenting this hasn't been attached to the load-plan packet yet, so I'll make sure that gets included before the huddle.
